messages:
Ivy Park: Hey team - quick kickoff for Meridian Health onboarding. Goal: pilot live in 30 days, capture renewal flags early. Short owners & timeline? :wave:
Carlos Mendes: I can own API integration + sample payload validation. Aim to have a smoke run by day 4.
Sana Ali: I'll own enablement and the playbook. Propose two 40-min sessions: integration walkthrough (wk1) and prompts+evals (wk2).
Leo Kim: I'll handle infra routing, batching, and cost-targets. Suggest start on a tiny Dedicated pool, batch size 6, prefix cache enabled.
Ivy Park: I already requested SOC2 and DPA from their security lead; will follow up if no reply in 48h. Exec sponsor is unclear - we should push for an intro before week 2.
Carlos Mendes: Requesting sample CSV and example user flows from them so we can map fields. If any PHI-like fields show up, flag immediately.
Sana Ali: Enablement checklist draft:
- Day 0: intros + roles
- Day 2: API keys & integration guide
- Day 6: prompt tuning session + 10-case eval
- Day 12: failover & monitoring runbook
- Day 30: pilot review and renewal signal
I'll share slide draft after day 2.
Leo Kim: Monitoring targets to capture in Console: p95 latency < 350ms, token cost cap per session, and success-rate of core flows. I'll add these to the dashboard once Sana posts session times.
Ivy Park: Risk notes: renewal-risk: medium (budget conversation pending), integration-complexity: low, exec-sponsor: TBD. We'll escalate if sponsor not confirmed by day 10.
Carlos Mendes: I'll post API examples here after the smoke run. Also will open tracker ticket for request/response diffs.
Sana Ali: We'll run pre/post prompt regression on the 10-case set; publishing results to the shared doc.
OnboardBot: Calendar invite: "Meridian Health - Onboarding Kickoff" 2025-11-12 11:00 PST (invite sent).
Ivy Park: Action items recap:
- Ivy: chase exec intro + SOC2/DPA (today)
- Carlos: smoke-run + sample payloads (day 4)
- Sana: enablement schedule + eval set (wk1)
- Leo: infra baseline config + dashboard tiles (48h)
If anything blocks, drop it here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
